gramInfo

gramInfo (grammatical information) groups those elements allowed within a <gramGrp> element in a dictionary.
Member of classes (none)  
Members colloc gramGrp lbl morphInfo [case gen gram itype mood number per tns] pos subc usg
Declaration 
<!ENTITY % x.gramInfo "" >
<!ENTITY % m.gramInfo "%x.gramInfo; %n.colloc; | %n.gramGrp; | %n.lbl; | 
%m.morphInfo; | %n.pos; | %n.subc; | %n.usg;">
Attributes Global attributes only
Module Declared in file teidict2.ent; Base tag set for dictionaries: enabled by TEI.dictionary
